t: The Qing was a Manchu dynasty that conquered Ming China in 1644 and ruled the world's most populous empire.
It reached its greatest extent in the 18th century, setting the territorial framework of modern China.
Rebellion, defeat in the Opium Wars and by Japan, and failed reform led to revolution and Puyi's abdication in 1912.
dyk: Nurhaci's Banner system organised the entire Jurchen population into colour-coded units that were at once army formations, census registers and social structures.
ev: Nurhaci proclaims the Later Jin dynasty
Hong Taiji proclaims the Qing dynasty
Wu Sangui opens the Shanhai Pass and Qing forces capture Beijing
The Qing conquer Taiwan from the Zheng regime, completing consolidation
Britain defeats the Qing in the First Opium War, forcing the Treaty of Nanjing
The Taiping Rebellion kills an estimated twenty to thirty million people
Japan defeats the Qing in the First Sino-Japanese War
The six-year-old Puyi abdicates, ending imperial rule in China
